assumptions.choice: Calculate the 200-period EMA, 60-period SMA, breakout, retest, and exits on the supplied 1-hour bars rather than H4 bars.
assumptions.reason: The fixed harness supplies only one already-created 1-hour data feed, and a Strategy class cannot replace or resample that Cerebro feed before execution.

assumptions.choice: A top-to-bottom break occurs when the prior close is above the prior EMA and the current close is at or below the current EMA.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define which OHLC price or equality convention constitutes a break.

assumptions.choice: On a bar after the breakout, require the low to touch or pass below the EMA, the close to finish at or above the EMA, and a bullish candle with close above open.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives a bullish candlestick or bounce only as examples and does not define a particular confirmation pattern.

assumptions.choice: Treat the bar high reaching the current 60-period SMA as reaching take-profit and the bar low reaching 70% of the executed entry price as a 30% stop-loss; submit self.close() when either happens.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not identify which intrabar price establishes that an exit level was reached; highs and lows preserve literal level touches available in OHLCV data.

assumptions.choice: Use the current 60-period SMA whenever it has 60 observations; otherwise use an entry-price target of plus 5%.
assumptions.reason: This implements the specified fallback definition, although automatic indicator warm-up means the 60-period SMA will ordinarily be available before the 200-period EMA can produce a signal.

assumptions.choice: Buy a fractional quantity worth 1% of current total portfolio value, calculated using the signal-bar close.
assumptions.reason: The specification requests a small position and gives 1-2% of total trading capital as its example without selecting an exact percentage or share-rounding rule.

assumptions.choice: Do not add a descending-resistance entry filter.
assumptions.reason: The specification describes considering descending resistance as a recommendation, provides no definition or period for calculating it, and says a break only makes entry more likely rather than making it mandatory.
